sentences.10.2 Vil dere komme i bryllupet vårt?: 10.2 Would you like to come to our wedding?
sentences.Sompit og Kjetil skal reise til Ålesund: Sompit and Kjetil are going to Ålesund early tomorrow morning, because they have been invited to a wedding.
sentences.Nå pakker de og gjør seg klare til å rei: Now they are packing and getting ready to leave.
sentences.Gleder du deg?: Are you looking forward to it?
sentences.Ja, jeg har jo aldri vært i bryllup i No: Yes, I've never been to a wedding in Norway, you know. And you?
sentences.Ja, jeg gleder meg veldig til å se Morte: Yes, I'm really looking forward to seeing Morten again. We were together almost every day at lower secondary and upper secondary school. He moved to Ålesund many years ago.
sentences.Ja, de bor ved sjøen litt utenfor sentru: Yes, they live by the sea a little outside the centre, in an old, newly renovated house.
sentences.Hvor skal vi bo, da?: Where are we going to stay, then?
sentences.Jeg har bestilt rom på et lite hotell i: I've booked a room at a small hotel in the centre. Our hotel is very cosy.
sentences.Kan foreldrene dine passe Bella?: Can your parents look after Bella?
Yes, my mum is picking her up tonight.
sentences.Kan jeg ha på meg den gule kjolen min i: Can I wear my yellow dress to the wedding?
sentences.Ja, du er fin i den. Har du kjøpt en gav: Yes, you look nice in it. Have you bought a present?
sentences.Ja, jeg har kjøpt en pen vase. Det er en: Yes, I've bought a pretty vase. It's a typical present for a bride and groom, they said in the shop.
sentences.Ja, det tror jeg. Vi har med klær til bå: Yes, I think so. We've got clothes for both the barbecue and the wedding: shoes, our toiletries and the present for the bride and groom.
sentences.Sompit og Kjetil skal reise til Ålesund: Sompit and Kjetil are going to a wedding in Ålesund.
sentences.Sompit gleder seg, for hun har aldri vær: Sompit is looking forward to it, because she has never been to a Norwegian wedding before.
Kjetil is looking forward to seeing Morten again.
sentences.De er barndomsvenner, men nå bor Morten: They are childhood friends, but now Morten lives in Ålesund.
sentences.Sompit og Kjetil har pakket alt, og Kjet: Sompit and Kjetil have packed everything, and Kjetil has booked a room at a hotel in the centre.
sentences.Foreldrene hans skal passe Bella, hunden: His parents are going to look after Bella, their dog, at the weekend.
